component.name: GoreeCloud Terminal
component.summary: Native GoreeCloud terminal for local shell workflows

description.p: GoreeCloud Terminal is a native GTK 4 and VTE terminal application for Linux. The current Development build provides local shell sessions, tabs, split panes, searchable scrollback, guarded paste review, portable local profiles, and versioned workspace restoration.
Remote administration, container workflows, production packaging, and Stable lifecycle qualification remain outside the current Development acceptance boundary.
